title: Choosing a Birthday Gift
source_credit: Original WorldVoice A1 learning dialogue · text-only; no voice recording has been published.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Hi, Adam. I need to buy a birthday gift.
dialogue.translation_ar: مرحبًا يا آدم. أحتاج إلى شراء هدية عيد ميلاد.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Who is the gift for, Lina?

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: It is for my friend Sara.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: When is her birthday?

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Her birthday is on Saturday.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: What does Sara like?

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: She likes books, music, and flowers.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: We can buy her a nice book.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Yes, but she has many books already.
dialogue.translation_ar: نعم، لكن لديها كتب كثيرة بالفعل.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Does she like green plants?

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Yes, she has plants in her room.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Let's choose a small plant for her desk.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: How much does this plant cost?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: It costs fifteen dollars.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: That is a good price.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Should we buy a birthday card too?
dialogue.translation_ar: هل ينبغي أن نشتري بطاقة عيد ميلاد أيضًا؟

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Of course. We can write a kind message.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: What can we write on the card?
dialogue.translation_ar: ماذا يمكننا أن نكتب على البطاقة؟

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: We can write, Happy birthday, Sara!
dialogue.translation_ar: يمكننا أن نكتب: عيد ميلاد سعيد يا سارة!

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Perfect. She will like our gift.

questions.question: How much does the plant cost?
